source_summary: Monochrome ink-and-wash Chinese landscape with layered cliffs, misty water, dense foreground trees, bamboo-like grove, and a small canopied boat carrying figures near the lower center. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_left_pine_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the pale ocher upper-left and upper-center mountain mass with sheer cliff faces, rounded plateaus, winding slopes, and clustered dark pine dots running along ridgelines and paths. Exclude the inscription and red seals on the upper right.
must_preserve: soft ocher wash over broad cliff planes
thin contour lines defining ledges and vertical drops
dark stippled pine clusters and needle-like tree marks
winding diagonal ridge path across the mountain
mist-softened edges where the mountain fades into background

motifs.name: mid_left_pine_saddle_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the middle-left saddle ridge descending from the high mountains, with a narrow pass, dark pine bands, exposed pale rock surfaces, and a small misty ravine separating upper and lower forms.
must_preserve: dense dark pine strokes following the crest
broken ink contour along the rocky edge
pale wash transitions suggesting mist-filled gaps
small scattered tree marks on the slope
irregular cliff silhouette

motifs.name: right_misty_far_mountains
motifs.description: Isolate the broad, pale distant mountain range across the middle-right background, including its jagged upper contour, shallow overlapping peaks, and hazy wash below. Exclude calligraphy and seals above.
must_preserve: faint ocher wash of receding cliffs
thin grey-brown outline of the ridge
overlapping interior peak contours
soft mist edge at the lower boundary
subtle horizontal water-wash bands near the base

motifs.name: left_foreground_gnarled_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the dense foreground grove on the lower left: large twisted trunks, spreading branches, tangled leaf clusters, underbrush, and rock bases. Keep the grove as a reusable foreground mass without the boat.
must_preserve: gnarled dark trunk linework
dense crisscross leaf and twig texture
exposed roots and rock outlines
tufts of vertical grasses at the base
layered ink washes inside the foliage masses

motifs.name: right_tall_bamboo_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the tall vertical grove at lower right, with slender clustered trunks, drooping branchlets, sparse leaf strokes, and dark grass tufts around the base.
must_preserve: long vertical trunk strokes with varied ink density
bending top branches and drooping leaves
thin lateral branch lines
dark base shadows and grass tufts
transparent wash that lets the background water remain airy

motifs.name: central_calm_water_basin
motifs.description: Isolate the calm central water surface and curving shoreline behind the boat, including the horizontal wash bands, pale open water, and soft bank contours. Exclude the boat and foreground trees as much as possible.
must_preserve: broad empty misty wash of the water
subtle horizontal ripples and tonal bands
curving shoreline line at the lower edge
soft transitions into distant banks
minimal ink marks that create quiet space

motifs.name: canopied_scholar_boat
motifs.description: Isolate the small boat near the lower center-right with its arched canopy, seated scholar, attendants, prow and stern curves, and the short landing fence or rail behind it.
must_preserve: arched canopy geometry and panel lines
seated scholar figure under the canopy
small attendant figures at the bow and beside the cabin
curved hull outline and stern shape
fine ink details on clothing, faces, poles, and rail

motifs.name: lower_rocky_riverbank
motifs.description: Isolate the lower foreground bank beneath the trees and boat: layered rock shelf, sloping earth forms, grasses, dark crevice strokes, and the curved ledge leading toward the water.
must_preserve: dark broken contour lines along the rock shelf
tufted grass strokes in vertical clusters
pale earth wash on sloping ground
ink-dark crevices and underside shadows
curving bank silhouette that supports figures and trees

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
